name: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp Ltd.
summary: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp Ltd. does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities in the digital financial infrastructure sector. The company was formerly known as Meteora Venture Partners Acquisition Corporation IV Ltd. and changed its name to Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp Ltd. in August 2025. Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp Ltd. was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Boca Raton, Florida.
